statement: An Xbox One curated family with model/revision variants is preferable to making Xbox One a subtype of Xbox Series: the source-backed identity matrix, Share omission, model-specific Bluetooth and SDL parsing differences are stable enough to require distinct native capability declarations. Share-neutral stick, trigger and button normalization and xpad uinput emission may be shared as helpers without claiming identical protocol or hardware identity.

applicability.revision: post-Alpha 2 family design recommendation, Microsoft Xbox One and One S standard controllers
applicability.scope: Architectural inference from pinned xpad, SDL and hid-microsoft; no implementation or host tests. Separate parent-null registry object.
